exposure: History of first-trimester recurrent spontaneous abortion (FRSA)
History of FRSA vs no history of FRSA
history of first-trimester recurrent spontaneous abortion (FRSA)
cohort: 492 singleton pregnant women, including 164 with a history of FRSA
finding: Women with a history of first-trimester recurrent spontaneous abortion had a higher incidence of cesarean section, pregnancy complications, and adverse maternal-placental-perinatal outcomes.
mod_finding: History of FRSA was an independent risk factor for cesarean section.
